what: Hand-labelled failure-log set for docs/jev-integration-plan.md insertion #2 (failure-log triage).
how: Every bgrun log under tools/bench/ modified 2026-09-20..22 whose LAST run ended rc!=0 or TIMEOUT, excluding peer_*/priorart_*/*retro*/cycle_*/selftest_*. Each summary (jev.summarise_failure) was read by the material session of 2026-09-22 and labelled by the FIRST failing gate / traceback line. diag_s57_typepair.log was dropped: its last run ended rc=0.

classes.script-bug: a Python error/typo/format/import defect, or a static checker refusing our own recipe; dies before or outside LabVIEW
classes.address-invalid: an index/uid/diagram_index resolves wrong or not at all ('not found', nodes_index None, stale Nodes[] index, wrong far end)
classes.labview-refused: 5001, ExecState 0 after an edit, an op that declined or silently no-op'd, a COM hang or timeout
classes.expected-reading: the run reached its own summary and the FAIL is a designed reading/arm or a refuted prediction about data; rc!=0 by design

labelled_by: material session, 2026-09-22, from jev.summarise_failure output only
